title: viola sylvestris subsp. insularis
intro: Viola sylvestris subsp. insularis, commonly known as the Island Violet, is a subspecies of the wood violet plant, native to the islands of the Baltic Sea. It is a type of flowering plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Viola sylvestris subsp. insularis include its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it useful in treating anxiety and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
